title: PyTorch Public Release
summary: The PyTorch team retrospectively marked January 19, 2017 as the date PyTorch was released publicly.
significance: A dated public-release milestone for the open-source PyTorch deep-learning framework, preserved as a release event rather than an inferred invention or system-birth date.

verification.note: A first-party PyTorch retrospective published January 19, 2018 states that the date marked one year since PyTorch was released publicly, supporting January 19, 2017 as the public-release date. A first-party Facebook AI Research retrospective independently states that PyTorch was announced at the beginning of 2017 and describes it as an open-source project. This candidate records the public-release milestone only; it does not infer PyTorch's invention date, development geography, universal priority, ancestry, influence, causality, or relationship edges.

sources.title: FAIR at 5: Facebook Artificial Intelligence Research accomplishments

candidateMeta.admissionReason: A dated first-party PyTorch retrospective directly supports January 19, 2017 as the public-release date, with a first-party Facebook AI Research retrospective corroborating the early-2017 announcement context.
